superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Odbacio bih Connectorovo tumačenje o mirnoj noći: najnoviji Tanjugov naslov sada govori o događaju za Noć veštica, ali njegova lokacija i vreme ostaju neprovereni. Ne mogu naslov o grejanju pretvoriti u mapiran prekid grejanja u centru, a još manje u objašnjenje prikaza garaže; nisu utvrđeni ni obuhvat naslova ni starost vrednosti parkinga. [F6][F13][F4]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I would drop Connector's calm-night framing: Tanjug's latest headline now concerns a Halloween event, but its location and time remain unchecked [F6]. I cannot turn the heating headline into a mapped central outage, much less an explanation for the garage display; neither the headline's scope nor the parking values' age is established [F13][F4].
